name: nagi
description: A calm blog theme with light serif headlines, a featured cover, numbered topics, a picture mosaic and a ledger of posts with large dates. Light and dark.

hero_kicker.title: Hero label
hero_kicker.description: Small line above the headline. Empty shows A journal by, then the newest author or the site name.

hero_title_italic.title: Hero headline, italic half
hero_title_italic.description: Shown after the headline in a muted italic.

hero_lede.title: Hero text
hero_lede.description: Empty uses the organisation description, then the tagline.

signup_form.title: Signup form
signup_form.description: Slug of a form that has a field named email and no captcha. Empty hides every signup and Subscribe link.

show_featured.title: Show the featured post
show_featured.description: The newest post with an image, next to the headline.

show_topics.title: Show the topic index
show_topics.description: The four categories with the most posts.

show_mosaic.title: Show the picture mosaic
show_mosaic.description: Needs at least three posts with images.

show_most_read.title: Show Further reading
show_most_read.description: The sidebar list of posts after the latest ones. It is not based on views.

footer_line.title: Footer sentence
footer_line.description: Empty uses the site tagline; no tagline means no sentence.

footer_line_italic.title: Footer sentence, italic half
footer_line_italic.description: Shown after the sentence in a muted italic.

color_mode.title: Colour mode
color_mode.description: What a first-time visitor sees. Visitors can still switch with the header toggle.
